results.content: Timeline View: Manage multiple projects on the same Gantt Chart - TeamBoard - Resource planning, project management and Gantt Chart for Jira, monday.com. Timeline View: Manage multiple projects on the same Gantt Chart. **_Are you managing multiple projects and wondering how you plan them on a single Gantt Chart? Gantt Chart is frequently used to manage a single project at a time. This chart is a plot of the time against the tasks allocated in the project. Once you have the Gantt chart designed and agreed upon by the project stakeholders, you can use this one document to keep your team updated and aware of their tasks and goals. In such cases, a single Gantt Chart combining the details of all the projects is required to give the details of resources, tasks, and required time for completion. The unique feature of having task details of all the projects on the same Gantt Chart is in the TeamBoard Jira plugin. A clear visual layout gives a bird-view of the goals of all the projects, individual teams goals, sprints, milestones under the same Gantt Chart. By dragging and dropping your project plans, you can easily schedule your tasks against the Gantt chart. An impression of the Gantt Chart for stakeholders gives an idea of the project status and individual tasks. Check out the linked issues with the given tasks, to see projects together from start to finish. Tasks displayed in Timeline are in the pipeline, that ladders up to project goals. From allocating resources, linking the tasks, issues, and schedule, view intermediate goals and milestones in the same chart. It’s great to have a dimensional view of tasks lined up for project completion. As most successfully planned and executed projects require adjustments, stretch the start and end day of the task or move the task horizontally to change the dates. Programs managers can see the details of all the projects in the same Gantt Chart. It’s easy to allocate the same resources for multiple projects with different tasks. The unique clear view of planned tasks, ladders up the multiple projects and company mission. One-Stop Solution for project management, resource planning, WBS gantt charts, time tracking, and timesheets.

results.content: Milestones & Sprints on Milestone Panel. # Milestones & Sprints on Milestone Panel. **Milestones Panel**is an additional panel appearing above the team members' timelines. **Milestones** can add significant value to project scheduling. 1. Create Milestone on the Milestones Panel by clicking on it;. By default, the Milestones Panel is hidden from the dashboard. Click on an empty cell in the Milestones Panel to open a dialog for new item creation. When a manager needs to set up an event (e.g., marketing demo) for a specific date and have everybody in the team to be aware of it, he/she should add an event to the Milestones panel. 1. Click on the empty cell in the milestones panel. 4. A new event is added to the milestones panel. Milestones panel can also show Jira tasks based on their due dates:. 2. The indication will be immediately put on a milestones panel. To activate this issue go to *Configurations → Timeline Panel → Display Issues on Milestones Panel based on Due date.*. To turn on a warning a couple of days before the due date (the title of the ticket becomes **bold**) possible in *Configurations → Timeline Panel → Deadline Warning Period.*. Fix Version in Jira is used for versioning your Project and to allocate some tasks to a specific release or delivery date. ActivityTimeline automatically reads the Fix Versions of a selected project (Click on the ⚙️ icon to choose the projects) and displays these Fix Versions on the Milestones panel based on the Release Date specified for each Fix Version in Jira. If the Release date in Jira is set on the 3rd of July then the milestone marked as [Release] with the title of Fix Version will appear on the specified date with a link on the Jira Fix Version page. It is possible to remove the Release note by clicking on the Red flag icon on the Release note (for manually created milestones only). ### Sprints on the Milestone panel. The add-on allows switching filters on or off in the milestones panel.

results.content: # Linking a created production sheet to a timeline or gannt to track milestones. For instance, my main production sheet is linked to a material tracking sheet. I create a purchase order and as the subcontractor reports their daily production, those quantities are subtracted from the PO sheet. My question is, because I have to create my own sheet, is there anyway to link my production tracker into a gannt chart or timeline sheet to give live milestones?
